library.title: Program Library
library.description: Browse and manage your reusable therapy programs.

retire.title: Delete program?
retire.description: This program will no longer appear for future treatment. Past patient sessions that used this program will stay unchanged.

create.title: Create program
create.description: Start from scratch or use a starter template. Either path opens the program editor before anything is saved to your library.
create.scratchDescription: Build a reusable program from the exercise library with standard default settings.
create.templateDescription: Begin from a curated exercise list, then review and edit before saving to your Program Library.

picker.title: Use a starter template
picker.description: Browse curated exercise lists. Templates show included exercises only; you can adjust settings in the editor before saving your program.
picker.previewDescription: Included exercises for the selected template.
picker.noExercises: This template has no enabled exercises to preview.
picker.selectPrompt: Select a starter template to preview its exercises.

editor.createDescription: Name your program and review settings, then add exercises if you need them before saving.
editor.finalizeDescription: Review settings, then add more exercises if you need them before saving.
editor.editDescription: Review settings, then add more exercises if you need them before saving.
editor.name: Name
editor.catalogTemplateDescription: Add or remove exercise variants, then return to settings to finish.
editor.catalogDescription: Choose exercises from the catalog, then return to settings to finish.
editor.editCatalogDescription: Add or remove exercise variants, then return to settings before saving.
editor.noExercisesError: You need to add at least one exercise.
